content_preview.title: Chrome Web Store Set to Purge All Remaining Manifest V2 Extensions on August 31, Leaving Firefox the Last Major Browser Fully Backing uBlock Origin
content_preview.summary: Google will remove every remaining Manifest V2 extension from the Chrome Web Store on August 31, 2026, completing a phase-out that has already disabled uBlock Origin and other legacy ad blockers in Chrome.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Google will complete its years-long phase-out of the Manifest V2 extension architecture on August 31, 2026, when it removes every remaining Manifest V2 extension from the Chrome Web Store, according to [Chrome for Developers](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/develop/migrate/mv2-deprecation-timeline). Extensions already installed on Chrome 138 or earlier will stay on users' machines but will be unable to receive updates and cannot be reinstalled from the Chrome Web Store ...

editor_notes.content_quality: Clear, well-organized News piece tracing a multi-year technical timeline plus its competitive fallout (Firefox vs. Chromium browsers). Correctly hedges on Edge/Opera's future support timeline in a 'What We Don't Know' section rather than assuming continuity.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read all 3 snapshots directly. Chrome for Developers confirms every date in the multi-year timeline verbatim (Jan 2022, Jun 2022, Jun 3 2024, Oct 9 2024, Mar 31 2025, Chrome 138/139) and the exact 'no longer turn them back on' quote. PCWorld confirms the Firefox Bluesky quote, the Chromium-browser list, and the Safari/DuckDuckGo non-support claim verbatim. Android Authority confirms the Devlin Cronin commit, the kExtensionManifestV2Disabled flag, both quotes attributed to Cronin, the 'Allow legacy extension manifest versions' flag detail, the Raymond Hill recommendation, and the Opera/Edge hedge quote verbatim -- and its June 17, 2026 byline supports the article's 'June 2026' dating of the commit.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: All specifics (dates, flag names, quotes) trace verbatim to their cited sources. No hallucinations or misattributions found.
editor_notes.originality: Not a duplicate -- no prior Manifest V2 coverage in the archive.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Approve. Every date, quote, and specific verified verbatim across all three sources; no corrections needed.
